name: You Stalker
tagline: Observe. Fix. Choose. A tool for attention awareness
description: You Stalker is a self-awareness tool inspired by the stalking practice from Carlos Castaneda’s works. It helps you break automatic emotional reactions, track your states, reflect through a daily review, and build conscious habits. Observe yourself, catch patterns in real time, and choose who you want to become — with clarity, presence, and inner strength.

name: FailFlow
tagline: You're going to die. Make the most of it.
description: An interactive visualization of how many weeks you have to live. Realizing that there is a finite, countable number of weeks you have to live is a great way to stop procrastinating!

name: Youtilitics
tagline: Take control of your utility data
description: Youtilitics is a utility data analysis tool that helps you save money. It shows you how much you are using on electricity, water, and gas. It helps you identify opportunities for savings, see statistics and contribute to a more sustainable future.

name: Zuiora
tagline: Homes with Empathy
description: Zuiora uses Lucy, an AI design assistant, to help you create living spaces that support preventive healthcare, psychological, and physiological wellbeing. Chat with Lucy about your space, preferences, and budget — she gives you specific material recommendations, color palettes, layouts, and room visualizations, all backed by 425+ peer-reviewed research papers in architectural and environmental psychology. She remembers your context across conversations, so every chat builds on the last.
